import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(it))
    t = [0] * 3001
    for _ in range(n):
        m = int(next(it))
        t[m] += 1
    k = int(next(it))
    for i in range(1, 3001):
        t[i] += t[i-1]
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, 5001 - k + 1):
        if i + k <= 5000:
            ans = max(ans, t[i+k] - t[i-1])
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
